pattern: WAI-ARIA progressbar role (ARIA 1.2) with a visible label.

aria.value: Localized percentage or valueText(); absent when indeterminate

keyboard.action: Not focusable; progress is conveyed through the progressbar role and optional live announcement.

focus: Not focusable. Focus is never moved by value changes.
notes: Value changes are not announced continuously; completion is announced once through the shared polite live region (announceComplete).
Non-default tones include a labelled icon so meaning never depends on color alone (1.4.1).
The indeterminate sweep is replaced by a static striped bar under prefers-reduced-motion or animation: none.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
